title: alchemilla splendens subsp. fulgens
intro: Alchemilla splendens subsp. fulgens, commonly known as the golden lady's mantle, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it an effective remedy for wounds, skin irritations, and menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla splendens subsp. fulgens include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
